title: Raw News Item
description: Loose contract for one incoming NewsNow article as received from a transport. Transport-agnostic; accepts extra publisher-specific fields.

id.description: Stable identifier supplied by the feed adapter. Must be unique within one ingest run.

publisher.description: Publisher or outlet name as supplied by the feed.

published_at.description: Publication timestamp in ISO-8601. Accepts explicit timezone or trailing Z.

description.description: Summary, deck, or lede when provided.

body.description: Full article body or best-effort extracted text.

content_hash.description: Optional precomputed content hash. Adapter recomputes its own authoritative hash.

source_feed.description: Identifier for the source feed or pipeline step that emitted this item.

extra.description: Free-form transport-specific metadata carried through unchanged.
